subject.title: perf(sqlite): fast schema gates, background integrity verification, and downgrade protection

question: Should the new persisted `database_verifications` table remain an unversioned additive cache that older builds ignore, or should it have an explicit migration/versioned upgrade contract?
rationale: This is a durable state and downgrade-policy decision; source inspection can verify the mechanics but cannot establish the intended long-term compatibility promise.

options.title: Approve additive-cache design after repair
options.body: Keep schema version 3, document the old-build behavior, and merge only after quarantine clearing is deferred until full repair validation succeeds.

options.title: Version the verification state
options.body: Treat persisted verification rows as a state-schema change and add an explicit versioned migration and upgrade contract before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve additive-cache design after repair
recommendation.body: Keep schema version 3, document the old-build behavior, and merge only after quarantine clearing is deferred until full repair validation succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete authored the proposed persisted-state and downgrade design and has recent merged ownership history in this SQLite area.
